og-4: a template classifies FORM; whether the intended reading is a stable attribute or a reported action is semantic and is never inferred from the shape
the shared rows (فعيل، فعول، فعال) never emit a final class; the intensive unit's transitivity test is required before any class claim
the diptote flag is a row property emitted WITHOUT the definiteness and annexation conditions that relax it; it is a prompt to check, not a case fact

method transfers, conclusions do not: a row matched on one lexeme never fixes the class of another lexeme on the same row
